stemMd: Anya: A scientific result should not be used in policy until another team reproduces it. Dario: In an emergency, a well-designed but unreplicated result may be the best available basis for action. They disagree over whether

options.label: A
options.textMd: independent replication is always a prerequisite for policy use.

options.label: C
options.textMd: replication can improve confidence in a result.

options.label: E
options.textMd: poorly designed research should guide policy.

explanationMd: Anya imposes an unconditional prerequisite; Dario provides an emergency exception. Their disagreement concerns whether the prerequisite admits exceptions, not whether replication generally improves reliability.

distractorRationale.b: Both discuss what evidence is sufficient.
